name: adminer
title: Adminer
description: A web page to browse and edit a database, behind a user name and password.
notes: Adminer is at https://{{domain}}, behind Team only: its user name is team, and its password is shown once after Create. At its own login, give the address of a database this server can reach. A database app of the same project and environment answers by name: <app>-<service>, or just <app> when it is that app's only service with ports, and its installed notice shows the exact address (the PostgreSQL template installed as postgres is postgres-postgres, port 5432). That needs a Caravana whose installed notice lists addresses: on an older one a database inside another Caravana app is not reachable by name.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Domain
inputs.help: Its DNS must point at this server.
